留置点内部比顾承安想象中要规整得多。

没有网上传的那么玄乎——什么审讯室挂满刑具、墙壁上写着“坦白从宽”之类的标语，也没有阴暗潮湿的地下室。整体像一个封闭式的疗养院，只不过住进来的人不太有康复出院的机会。

江绍庭被带进去之后，第一道程序就是换衣服。

所有个人衣物全部收走，统一换上一套灰蓝色棉质套装，拖鞋是软底的，没有鞋带。腰带、皮带都不允许保留，裤子的松紧

刚开始，开始胖局长还没有考虑到这个问题，经由助手这么一说，事情倒也确实奇怪。

吴宇和孙晓奚最终决定在公墓举办婚礼，虽然这大大的影响了参加他们婚礼的人数，但是在吴宇的解释下，孙晓奚最终还是同意了吴宇的想法。

杀人者，不管是谁，只需要支付三十磅的黄金，它们便会为买主扫清一切障碍。

“对，我也不信！除非他亲口承认，否则的话，我是肯定不会相信的。”说话的是一个黑鬼将军的死忠粉，摆明了一种态度：就算有证据也不信。

凯丽带着杰克和威特在前面带路，乔治坐在沈幕雨的路虎上指路。

玛丽哥鲁德望了一眼自己的姐姐桑达索尼亚，她皱了皱眉，寻思道。

“胡说，丹天王怎么可能放弃我？我跟了他那么久时间，难道连这点自信还没有么？”夜莺傲然说道。

诺尔公主这点话还是能听懂的，不就是影射我么。“那本宫谢谢了。”两个“本宫”搞得兰朵朵心烦意乱。

然而那美目中蕴含的滚滚泪珠却让苏离心中燃起的火焰，一时感到迷茫。

尤其是凌晨，这是父母亲手做的饭菜，都是自己十三年没有尝过的味道了。

右拳随着一声怒吼挥下，重重的砸在了那道障壁上，停格了数秒后，随着“咔咔”的响声，白色屏障猛地碎裂开来。

一旁慕安的额头开始滋滋盗汗，他心下一紧：这个叫贾语的男人竟然这般难灌醉，可得想个计策应付才行。

正当无计可施之时，一暗器从窗外穿刺而入，险些刺中了她，显然发暗器之人故意射偏了。

“竟然是你，玄天！”蔚言吃惊不已，玄天怎么会知道自己的行踪？

简竹失魂落魄后好不容易清醒过来，又一次瞧见这个熟悉的背影、有些落拓孤单的背影，却带着无与伦比的安全感。

刚要起身却忽然发现陈飞竟然已经鬼魅般的来到了自己面前，看着陈飞那狰狞的冷笑腾光进竟然愣住了忘记了做出防御。不过即便他想起来也来不及了，陈飞的拳头已经如同狂风骤雨一般袭来。

“还是先观察一下你的这三条办法灵不灵吧，要是灵的话，那李仙和红娘子就没有罪了，要是不灵的话，他俩该怎么办还是怎么办。”云中游终究还是他一锤子定音。

“呼！”还没等那个口出脏字骂人的闹事者反应过来，这橙红色的火球便从易川的手掌上脱离了下来，瞬间便飞到了那个新人的面前，在这新人惊恐的眼神中，这火球竟然穿透了木栅栏的隔离，狠狠的砸在了自己的嘴巴上。

有些伤楚，即使你掩饰的再好，在完美，可是，从你骨子里透露出来的伤楚，还是能清晰的感觉的到的。

但他也没有隐藏，他不相信白若离会对他做什么杀人越货的事，这是一种信任与信心。

张丽秀眉微皱，东海是什么地方，没有人结伴而行，没有任何一个在东海的亲戚朋友，又从没出过大山，她不明白陆山民的家人怎么就这么放心把他给放出来。

The interior of the detention site was much more orderly than Gu Chengan had imagined.

It is not as mysterious as what is posted on the Internet - there is no interrogation room filled with torture instruments, slogans such as "Leniency for Confessions" written on the walls, and there is no dark and damp basement.The whole thing is like a closed nursing home, except that the people who live in it have little chance of recovery and discharge.

After Jiang Shaoting was brought in, the first procedure was to change clothes.

All personal clothes were put away and put on a gray-blue cotton suit. The slippers were soft-soled and had no laces.Belts and belts are not allowed to be kept, and the elasticity of trousers is not allowed.

At first, the fat director hadn't considered this issue. After his assistant said this, things were indeed strange.

Wu Yu and Sun Xiaoxi finally decided to hold their wedding in the cemetery. Although this greatly affected the number of people attending their wedding, under Wu Yu's explanation, Sun Xiaoxi finally agreed to Wu Yu's idea.

The murderer, whoever he was, had only to pay thirty pounds of gold, and they would clear all obstacles for the buyer.

"Yes, I don't believe it either! Unless he admits it himself, I will definitely not believe it." The person who spoke was a die-hard fan of the black ghost general, making it clear that he would not believe it even if there was evidence.

Kelly led the way with Jack and Witt, while George sat on Shen Muyu's Land Rover to guide the way.

Marigold glanced at his sister Sandasonia, she frowned and thought.

"Nonsense, how could King Dan give up on me? I've been with him for so long, don't I even have this little confidence?" Nightingale said proudly.

I can still understand what Princess Noel said, isn't it just an insinuation of me?"Thank you, I." The two "I" made Lan Duoduo upset.

However, the rolling tears contained in those beautiful eyes ignited the fire in Su Li's heart and made him feel confused for a moment.

Especially in the early morning, this is a meal cooked by my parents, which I have not tasted in thirteen years.

The right fist was swung down with a roar, and it hit the barrier hard. After stopping for a few seconds, with a "click" sound, the white barrier suddenly shattered.

Mu An's forehead began to break out in night sweats, and he felt nervous: This man named Jia Yu was so difficult to get drunk, so he had to think of a plan to deal with it.

Just when there was nothing to do, a hidden weapon pierced through the window and almost hit her. Apparently the person who issued the hidden weapon missed the target intentionally.

"It's you, Xuantian!" Wei Yan was shocked. How could Xuantian know his whereabouts?

Jian Zhu finally regained consciousness after losing her soul. She once again saw this familiar figure, a somewhat lonely figure, but with an unparalleled sense of security.

Just as he was about to get up, he suddenly found that Chen Fei had come to him like a ghost. Looking at Chen Fei's ferocious sneer, Teng Guangjin was stunned and forgot to defend himself.But even if he thought about it, it was too late, Chen Fei's fist had already hit him like a violent storm.

"Let's first observe whether your three methods work. If they work, then Li Xian and Madam Hong are not guilty. If they don't work, what should they do?" Yun Zhongyou finally made the final decision.

"Hoo!" Before the troublemaker who was swearing and swearing could react, the orange-red fireball detached from Yi Chuan's palm and flew in front of the newcomer in an instant. In the newcomer's horrified eyes, the fireball actually penetrated the isolation of the wooden fence and hit his mouth hard.

Some hurts, no matter how well you hide them, are perfect, but the hurts revealed in your bones can still be clearly felt.

But he didn't hide it. He didn't believe that Bai Ruoli would do anything to kill or rob him. This was a kind of trust and confidence.

Zhang Li frowned slightly, what kind of place was the East China Sea? No one traveled together, she didn't have any relatives or friends in the East China Sea, and she had never been out of the mountains. She didn't understand how Lu Shanmin's family could be so relieved to release him.
